text: The Patriots dominated the Steelers 20-3 in their Week 2 home opener at Gillette Stadium, with TreVeyon Henderson punching in a touchdown as the defense largely carried the load while the offense continues searching for the rhythm that fueled last season's Super Bowl run, though the victory came at a cost as starting right guard Mike Onwenu suffered a broken right ankle that initial X-rays confirmed. Head Coach Mike Vrabel addressed the team's performance and injury situation in Monday's press conference, with both he and select players offering postgame reflections on a win that saw the Patriots become the first of the original AFL teams to reach 600 victories—a historic milestone that underscores the franchise's remarkable consistency even as the offensive identity remains a work in progress.
